project_claims.evidence: The V9/V10 dependent score and nuisance-rate argument is project work; DML supplies only the inspected orthogonal-score and nuisance-product premise.
The inherited Bartlett alternative traces to the inspected Newey--West original; the fixed-horizon scalar covariance is project work.
Exact audit inversion, set projection and rank-one behavior are project derivations and numerical checks, not claims borrowed from the two papers.
The 3,000-request coverage, width and availability comparisons are newly registered synthetic results, not primary-paper findings.

search_scope: No new discovery, version or correction search. Reuses and verifies two already inspected original technical copies under their narrow source roles.
